text: The property experienced tree-cover loss in 2021, confirmed by satellite data. About 81.3 hectares (2.23% of the 3,643.5-ha asset) of planted forest—primarily *Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*—was lost. The loss was corroborated by updates in 2025, ensuring accuracy. About 68.1 hectares were within mapped planted forests, with 13.2 hectares outside. Smaller patches (under 0.5 ha) totaling 37.3 hectares were excluded. The cause (e.g., harvest, fire) and legality are unspecified. This aligns with earlier pending data from 2022, which lacked later-year confirmation. The change is persistent but not classified as deforestation or illegal activity.
